c1-monetaris-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pengő in 1946
c1-monetaris-01.scenario: In a history seminar on Hungarian money you are asked what happened to the pengő in 1946.
c1-monetaris-01.prompt: Say what happened to prices in the summer of 1946 and what replaced the pengő.
cues: Name the new currency and the date
c1-monetaris-01.target: 1946 nyarán az árak nagyjából tizenöt óránként megduplázódtak. 1946. augusztus 1-jén a forint váltotta fel a pengőt.
c1-monetaris-01.english: In the summer of 1946 prices doubled about every fifteen hours. On 1 August 1946 the forint replaced the pengő.
c1-monetaris-01.canDo: I can describe the hyperinflation of 1945–46 and the introduction of the forint in 1946 (*hiperinfláció, valutareform*).

c1-monetaris-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bokros Package
c1-monetaris-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the stabilization package of 1995.
c1-monetaris-02.prompt: Say when the package was announced, by whom, and how its effect is judged.
cues: Give the date and the minister
Give a hedged judgement of the result
c1-monetaris-02.target: 1995. március 12-én Bokros Lajos pénzügyminiszter stabilizációs csomagot jelentett be. Bár a csomag fájdalmas volt, sok elemző szerint javította az ország külső egyensúlyát.
c1-monetaris-02.english: On 12 March 1995 Finance Minister Lajos Bokros announced a stabilization package. Although the package was painful, many analysts say it improved the country's external balance.
c1-monetaris-02.canDo: I can describe the Bokros Package of 1995 (*Bokros-csomag, kiigazítás, ikerdeficit*).

c1-monetaris-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Band of 2003
c1-monetaris-03.scenario: In an economics seminar you are asked about the forint in the exchange rate band.
c1-monetaris-03.prompt: Say what happened in January 2003 and what changed in February 2008.
cues: Mention the speculators and the central bank
Mention the end of the band
c1-monetaris-03.target: 2003 januárjában a spekulánsok a forint erősödési sávszélét támadták. A jegybank kénytelen volt eurót vásárolni, 2008 februárjában pedig a forint szabadon lebegővé vált.
c1-monetaris-03.english: In January 2003 speculators attacked the strong edge of the forint band. The central bank was forced to buy euros, and in February 2008 the forint began to float freely.
c1-monetaris-03.canDo: I can describe exchange rate regimes (*intervenciós sáv, szabad lebegtetés*).

c1-monetaris-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Swiss Franc Loans
c1-monetaris-04.scenario: In a seminar on household debt you are asked why the Swiss franc loans became a problem.
c1-monetaris-04.prompt: Explain the risk of a franc loan and say what the law of 2014 provided.
c1-monetaris-04.target: A forint gyengülésekor a frankhitelek törlesztőrészletei sok háztartásnál megnőttek. 2014-ben törvények rendelkeztek a devizahitelek forintosításáról.
c1-monetaris-04.english: When the forint weakened, the instalments of franc loans rose for many households. In 2014 laws provided for the conversion of foreign currency loans into forints.
c1-monetaris-04.canDo: I can describe the Swiss franc mortgage crisis (*devizahitel, árfolyamrés, forintosítás*).

c1-monetaris-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Euro Debate
c1-monetaris-05.scenario: In an economics seminar you are asked how the arguments about adopting the euro divide.
c1-monetaris-05.prompt: Give one argument for the euro and one condition that many economists name.
cues: Name one advantage of the euro
Say what many economists require first
c1-monetaris-05.target: Az euró megszüntetné a tranzakciós költségeket. Sok közgazdász szerint viszont csak megfelelő reálkonvergencia esetén érdemes bevezetni.
c1-monetaris-05.english: The euro would remove transaction costs. Many economists say, however, that it is worth introducing only once real convergence is adequate.
c1-monetaris-05.canDo: I can describe the Maastricht convergence criteria (*maastrichti kritériumok, ERM II*).

c1-monetaris-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Forint in Summary
c1-monetaris-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the history of the forint.
c1-monetaris-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the story from 1946 to 2008 in two sentences.
cues: Say what the forint stopped in 1946
c1-monetaris-consolidation.target: 1946-ban a forint megállította a pengő pénzromlását, 2008 februárjában pedig szabadon lebegővé vált. A devizahitel-válság megmutatta, hogy a devizakockázat a háztartásokat is érinti.
c1-monetaris-consolidation.english: In 1946 the forint halted the pengő's currency collapse, and in February 2008 it began to float freely. The foreign currency loan crisis showed that currency risk also affects households.
c1-monetaris-consolidation.canDo: I can recount the history of the forint from the hyperinflation of 1946 to the Bokros Package of 1995.

c1-energetika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Paks in Hungarian Electricity
c1-energetika-01.scenario: In a seminar on Hungarian energy you are asked about the Paks Nuclear Power Plant.
c1-energetika-01.prompt: Say when the first unit was connected to the grid and what share of electricity Paks gives.
cues: Give the month and year of the first unit
c1-energetika-01.target: 1982 decemberében az 1-es blokk rákapcsolódott az országos villamosenergia-hálózatra. Az erőmű ma a hazai áramtermelés mintegy felét adja.
c1-energetika-01.english: In December 1982 unit 1 was connected to the national grid. Today the plant provides about half of domestic electricity generation.
c1-energetika-01.canDo: I can describe the history of the Paks Nuclear Power Plant and its place in Hungarian electricity (*Paksi Atomerőmű, blokk, üzemidő-hosszabbítás*).

c1-energetika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Paks II Agreement
c1-energetika-02.scenario: In a seminar you are asked about the Paks II agreement of 2014.
c1-energetika-02.prompt: Say what the agreement provided and what the critics say.
c1-energetika-02.target: 2014 januárjában a magyar és az orosz kormány két új blokk építéséről állapodott meg. A bírálók szerint a projekt az orosz technológiától való függőséget növeli.
c1-energetika-02.english: In January 2014 the Hungarian and Russian governments agreed on building two new units. According to the critics the project increases dependence on Russian technology.
c1-energetika-02.canDo: I can describe the Paks II agreement and the debate about it (*államközi szerződés, fővállalkozói szerződés*).

c1-energetika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Danube Dispute
c1-energetika-03.scenario: In a seminar on the environment you are asked about the Bős–Nagymaros dispute.
c1-energetika-03.prompt: Say what the Danube Circle protested against and what the court decided in 1997.
c1-energetika-03.target: A Duna Kör a Bős–Nagymaros vízlépcső ellen tiltakozott. A hágai bíróság 1997-ben megállapította, hogy mindkét fél megszegett kötelezettségeket.
c1-energetika-03.english: The Danube Circle protested against the Bős–Nagymaros barrage. In 1997 the court in The Hague found that both sides had breached obligations.
c1-energetika-03.canDo: I can describe the Bős–Nagymaros dispute and the ruling of 1997 (*vízlépcső, Duna Kör, C-variáns*).

c1-energetika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Geothermal Heating
c1-energetika-04.scenario: In a seminar on energy you are asked about geothermal heat in Hungary.
c1-energetika-04.prompt: Say why the Pannonian Basin is favourable and what Szeged does with thermal water.
cues: Say what is special about the basin
c1-energetika-04.target: A Pannon-medencében a hőmérséklet gyorsabban emelkedik a mélységgel, mint a világátlag. Szegeden a hévíz a távfűtés egy részét fedezi.
c1-energetika-04.english: In the Pannonian Basin the temperature rises faster with depth than the world average. In Szeged thermal water covers part of the district heating.
c1-energetika-04.canDo: I can describe geothermal energy in the Pannonian Basin and district heating in Szeged (*hévíz, távfűtés, visszasajtolás*).

c1-energetika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Solar Boom
c1-energetika-05.scenario: In a seminar on energy you are asked about solar power in Hungary.
c1-energetika-05.prompt: Say how large solar capacity was by 2024 and what problem arises at midday.
cues: Give the capacity and the year
c1-energetika-05.target: 2024-re a napelemes kapacitás átlépte a hatezer megawattot. Délben a túltermelés miatt az áramár negatív lehet.
c1-energetika-05.english: By 2024 solar capacity had exceeded six thousand megawatts. At midday the overproduction can make the electricity price negative.
c1-energetika-05.canDo: I can describe the growth of solar power in Hungary and the problems it brings (*naperőmű, negatív áramár, tárolás*).

c1-energetika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Energy in Summary
c1-energetika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up Hungarian energy supply.
c1-energetika-consolidation.prompt: Sum it up in two sentences, using one fact from the nuclear part and one from the renewable part.
c1-energetika-consolidation.target: Paks a hazai áramtermelés mintegy felét adja. Szegeden a hévíz a távfűtés egy részét fedezi, a napenergia pedig 2024-re átlépte a hatezer megawattot.
c1-energetika-consolidation.english: Paks provides about half of domestic electricity generation. In Szeged thermal water covers part of the district heating, and solar power exceeded six thousand megawatts by 2024.
c1-energetika-consolidation.canDo: I can recount the history of Paks I and the debate about extending its lifetime.

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Language Models
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.scenario: In a seminar on Hungarian language technology you are asked why Hungarian needs its own language models.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.prompt: Say who built the Puli models and why the Hungarian language is a special case.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.target: A Puli modelleket a HUN-REN Nyelvtudományi Kutatóközpont kutatói fejlesztették. A magyar nyelv szabad szórendje kiváltképp próbára teszi a gépi elemzést.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.english: The Puli models were developed by researchers of the HUN-REN Research Centre for Linguistics. The free word order of Hungarian puts machine parsing especially to the test.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-01.canDo: I can describe Hungarian research on language models (*nyelvi modell, kutatóhálózat, Puli*).

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The AI Act
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.scenario: In a seminar on technology law you are asked about the EU AI Act.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.prompt: Say what kind of approach the regulation takes and give one reason for oversight.
cues: Give a reason with annál is inkább, mivel
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.target: A rendelet kockázatalapú megközelítést alkalmaz. Az emberi felügyelet fontos, annál is inkább, mivel a rendszerek jogokat érinthetnek.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.english: The regulation takes a risk-based approach. Human oversight is important, all the more so since the systems can affect rights.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-02.canDo: I can describe the EU AI Act and its risk levels (*AI Act, nagy kockázatú rendszerek, megfelelőségi értékelés*).

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Automation and Work
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.scenario: In an economics seminar you are asked how artificial intelligence changes work.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.prompt: Say which kind of work is now affected and what many experts say about reskilling.
cues: Refer to the experts or research
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.target: A kutatások tanúsága szerint az MI a fehérgalléros munkákat is érinti. Sok szakértő szerint az átképzés egyre fontosabb.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.english: According to research, AI also affects white-collar jobs. According to many experts reskilling is becoming more important.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-03.canDo: I can describe how automation changes work and why reskilling matters (*kognitív automatizáció, átképzés*).

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Medical AI
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.scenario: In a seminar on medicine and technology you are asked who should decide in the clinic.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.prompt: Concede that the software is good, but say who makes the final diagnosis.
cues: Concede the quality of the software
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.target: Bármilyen kifinomult is a szoftver, a végső diagnózist az orvos állítja fel. Fontos, hogy az orvos mondja ki a végső szót.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.english: However sophisticated the software is, the final diagnosis is made by the doctor. It is important that the doctor has the final say.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-04.canDo: I can describe how AI is used in medical imaging and diagnosis (*képalkotás, radiológiai diagnosztika, klinikai döntéstámogatás*).

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Alignment Problem
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.scenario: In a seminar on philosophy and technology you are asked where the danger of general AI lies.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.prompt: Say where many thinkers see the danger, using nem ... hanem.
cues: Say what is not the danger
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.target: Sok gondolkodó szerint nem a gép intellektusa jelenti a veszélyt, hanem az értékek tisztázatlansága.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.english: According to many thinkers it is not the intellect of the machine that poses the danger, but the lack of clarity about values.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-05.canDo: I can discuss the alignment problem and the risks of general AI (*AGI, összehangolási probléma, kontrollprobléma*).

c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.title: Communicative Challenge: AI in Summary
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the unit on artificial intelligence.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.prompt: Sum it up in two sentences.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.target: A rendelet kockázatalapú megközelítést alkalmaz. Bármilyen pontos is a modell, a felelősség az embereké.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.english: The regulation takes a risk-based approach. However accurate the model is, responsibility lies with people.
c1-mestersegesintelligencia-consolidatio.canDo: I can recount Hungarian research on language models and the aims of the EU AI Act.

c1-mediakritika-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The KESMA
c1-mediakritika-01.scenario: In a seminar on the media you are asked about the foundation formed in 2018.
c1-mediakritika-01.prompt: Say what the KESMA is and how the critics judge it.
cues: Say when and what was formed
c1-mediakritika-01.target: 2018. november 28-án kormányközeli tulajdonosok csaknem ötszáz médiuma egyetlen alapítványba, a KESMA-ba került. A kritikusok szerint ez nemhogy nem növelte a versenyt, sőt éppenséggel szűkítette a sokszínűséget.
c1-mediakritika-01.english: On 28 November 2018 nearly five hundred outlets of owners close to the government went into a single foundation, the KESMA. According to the critics this not only did not increase competition, on the contrary, it narrowed diversity.
c1-mediakritika-01.canDo: I can describe media concentration and the KESMA (*médiapiaci koncentráció, KESMA, állami hirdetések*).

c1-mediakritika-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Echo Chambers
c1-mediakritika-02.scenario: In a seminar on social media you are asked how algorithms shape what people read.
c1-mediakritika-02.prompt: Say what an echo chamber is and give your judgement with aggasztó módon.
cues: Say what an echo chamber means
c1-mediakritika-02.target: A véleménybuborékban főként a saját nézeteinket megerősítő tartalmakat látjuk. Aggasztó módon ezt a közösségi média algoritmusai is erősíthetik.
c1-mediakritika-02.english: In an echo chamber we mainly see content that confirms our own views. Worryingly, the algorithms of social media can reinforce this too.
c1-mediakritika-02.canDo: I can describe how algorithmic filters can create echo chambers (*véleménybuborék, megerősítési torzítás*).

c1-mediakritika-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Deepfakes
c1-mediakritika-03.scenario: In a seminar on information security you are asked about deepfakes.
c1-mediakritika-03.prompt: Give both sides of the problem with egyfelől ... másfelől viszont.
c1-mediakritika-03.target: Egyfelől a mélyhamisítások új veszélyt jelentenek, másfelől viszont a tényellenőrzés segíthet a felismerésükben.
c1-mediakritika-03.english: On one hand deepfakes pose a new danger, on the other hand fact-checking can help to recognise them.
c1-mediakritika-03.canDo: I can describe disinformation, deepfakes and information warfare (*dezinformáció, mélyhamisítás, hibrid hadviselés*).

c1-mediakritika-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Pegasus Case
c1-mediakritika-04.scenario: In a seminar on press freedom you are asked about the Pegasus case of 2021.
c1-mediakritika-04.prompt: Say who reported it and what the critics say should be required.
cues: Name the news portal and the year
Say what is expected of surveillance
c1-mediakritika-04.target: 2021 júliusában a Direkt36 számolt be a Pegasus-ügyről. A bírálók szerint elvárható, hogy a megfigyelést független bírói kontroll mellett engedélyezzék.
c1-mediakritika-04.english: In July 2021 Direkt36 reported on the Pegasus case. According to the critics it is to be expected that surveillance be authorised with independent judicial control.
c1-mediakritika-04.canDo: I can describe the Pegasus case and the protection of journalistic sources (*Pegasus, kémszoftver, forrásvédelem*).

c1-mediakritika-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Reader Funding
c1-mediakritika-05.scenario: In a seminar on the media you are asked how independent newsrooms can survive.
c1-mediakritika-05.prompt: Say what supporters point to and stress that even a small amount helps.
c1-mediakritika-05.target: A támogatók az olvasói előfizetésekre és mikroadományokra hivatkoznak. Még a legkisebb adomány is segíthet.
c1-mediakritika-05.english: The supporters refer to reader subscriptions and microdonations. Even the smallest donation can help.
c1-mediakritika-05.canDo: I can describe reader funding and the resilience of the independent press (*közösségi finanszírozás, olvasói támogatás*).

c1-mediakritika-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Media in Summary
c1-mediakritika-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the unit on the media.
c1-mediakritika-consolidation.prompt: Sum it up in two sentences.
c1-mediakritika-consolidation.target: A bírálók szerint a médiapiac koncentrációja korántsem szolgálta a sokszínűséget. A támogatók szerint az olvasók is hozzájárulhatnak a független sajtó fennmaradásához.
c1-mediakritika-consolidation.english: According to the critics the concentration of the media market was far from serving diversity. According to the supporters, readers can also contribute to the survival of the independent press.
c1-mediakritika-consolidation.canDo: I can recount the debate about media concentration and the KESMA.
